ctx.x: So (unintelligible). The man in charge of recording that band was -- what's the name of this fellow? His arrangements -- Leroy Holmes. (Unintelligible) got ahold of Tito and says, Tito, this is your last album. I wish you'd let me do something. Get yourself about ten good boleros, bring them to me and let me write it and make the arrangement, get the type of thing I want them to do. (Inaudible.) There's only one more album, anyhow.

See, what happened, they recorded the album, they had a tune in there about (unintelligible). That tune hit in Buenos Aires and from Buenos Aires all the way back over here. And from then on, that band made some money.
